observations.trace: Haircut.length clamps the ordinary non-fringe branch to at least0.0005, but a matching Fringe returns 0.1 + drop earlier. With a matching fringe, directly supplied drop=-0.1, zero variation and dome0, the static length expression is zero; Hairdo.comb starts with one root and has zero steps, then guides passes that one-point path to resample_into with a nonempty output. arc_lengths makes one length and resample_into indexes lengths[1].
observations.remaining: This depends on a matching sampled root, admissibility of a negative fringe drop, a finite otherwise valid head and prior operations succeeding. No hairdo, loop, sampler or panic ran. Original q381 is the existing first resampling contract; this is a connected producer, not a duplicate unique finding.

observations.trace: Public Hairdo.guides takes raw usize points and ultimately calls Strands::with_capacity, whose constructor asserts at least two. A direct zero-points call has no local points admission. Look.guides instead passes64; Groom.grow_while normalizes its requested points with max(2).
observations.remaining: The failure is conditional on the direct API and earlier source operations succeeding, with zero-count semantics unchosen. Historical q378 concerns a separate default Strands admission first cut. No guide creation ran.

observations.trace: Hairdo.guide_count selects110/140/160; its count*40 and the GPU recipient therefore stay below u32 capacity. Original delegate754 already established this. Groom.grow_reporting supplies an always-true cancellation closure to grow_while, which returns Some after the operations, so the expect does not fail by ordinary cancellation.
observations.remaining: Historical source reviewer attribution is preserved; neither guarantee covers extreme hair lengths, surface admission, panics inside operations or runtime outcomes.

observations.trace: Hairdo keeps arrangement-derived flow in an enum with payloads, parting uses typed variants and the braid producer supplies three lanes. Groom records Op.name only for human-readable reporting and executes typed Op values.
observations.remaining: Native shader encoding, all producer shapes and cancellation effects remain separate; final diagnostic strings are not treated as internal classifier defects. Source tests were read only.
